scope: Current Memoh packaged-client lifecycle, theme and foreground voice bridge.
registration: synchronous methodList=['request']; asyncMethodList=[]; explicit custom-scheme permission plus synchronous last-calling-frame URL and main-page URL guard
frame_limit: SDK exposes frame URL, not a top-frame identity. Same-URL packaged iframe identity is not distinguishable; packaged document subframe loads are denied by native interceptor, packaged CSP retains frame restrictions. No runtime frame attestation claimed.
request: {version:1,command,state?,themeId?,handle?,offset?}; trusted packaged frame only. Commands do not accept arbitrary filesystem paths or execution.

commands.client.state: state:'login-page'|'ready'|'failed'; state is the only command field beyond version and command; trusted packaged page only. login-page reports the current Memoh login form; ready and failed report current client readiness. Document load alone does not establish ready. Missing client report after document load has the existing 60s active timer and explicit manual retry; no automatic reload/resend, late valid completion may still recover.
commands.client.theme: themeId from contracts/ui_theme.json; apply native surface and system-bar colors without changing conversation or transfer state.
commands.voice.start: handle:32 lowercase hex; ready client only. Check/request native microphone permission and capture one foreground 16kHz mono S16LE PCM source for the private WAV and native recognizer.
commands.voice.status: handle; return current CaptureStatus {handle,state,durationMs,peaks,text,speechError} for that capture.
commands.voice.stop: handle; stop capture and finalize the same WAV, returning CaptureResult with bytes and audible.
commands.voice.transcribe: handle; finalize the same captured source and await its native recognition result. No second microphone stream or full-audio replay.
commands.voice.cancel: handle; cancel that capture and release its unfinished private source.
commands.voice.read: handle,offset; return the bounded private WAV slice for the existing capture. No arbitrary path.
commands.voice.release: handle; release the retained capture source.

voice_source: The same native copied PCM samples feed WAV, duration/peak measurements and the existing speech worker.
web_attachments: Current selected-file preparation, integrity verification, authenticated original reads and native send use the official Memoh SDK. This contract does not assert background/process-death transfer or paired album synchronization.
acceptance: Actual source-bound device behavior and remaining limitations belong to docs/CURRENT_STAGE.md.
